summary_en: This study tests a brief exercise program given before radiation therapy and surgery in people with soft tissue sarcoma in an arm or leg. The exercise is done right before radiation, during the usual 10-week radiation course, using rubber bands for leg tumors or a hand-held dynamometer for arm tumors; how often it is done is not stated. The record does not state a main outcome measure; its stated purpose is to evaluate effects on limb function and wound healing after surgery, and the phase is listed as NA.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba un programa breve de ejercicio que se realiza antes de la radioterapia y la cirugía en personas con sarcoma de tejido blando en un brazo o una pierna. El ejercicio se hace justo antes de la radioterapia, durante el tratamiento habitual de 10 semanas, usando bandas elásticas para tumores en la pierna o un dinamómetro manual para tumores en el brazo; la frecuencia no está indicada. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; su propósito declarado es evaluar los efectos en la función de la extremidad y la cicatrización de la herida después de la cirugía, y la fase aparece como NA.
who_for: Soft tissue sarcoma confirmed by pathology in an upper or lower extremity
Planned radiation therapy before surgical removal of the tumor
Expected primary wound closure at surgery
Able to attend follow-up visits and give own consent
not_for: Prior radiation to the tumor or surgical area
Prior surgery at the disease site other than biopsy
Chemotherapy within the last 30 days or high-dose steroids
Tumor ulcerating or fungating through the skin, or severe cardiopulmonary disease
